I interviewed forty engineers this spring and asked every one of them the same question: what did you delete last month?

Half of them paused. A third told me about a feature they had added instead.

Seven people had an answer ready. Six of them got offers.

Deleting code is the only engineering skill that never shows up on a resume, so it is the only one worth asking about out loud.
